structure.unit: Uniform Adult Guardianship and Protective Proceedings Jurisdiction Act

text.section: A court of the Commonwealth may communicate with a court in another state concerning a proceeding arising under this chapter. The court may allow the parties to participate in the communication. Except as otherwise provided in subsection B, the court shall make a record of the communication. The record may be limited to the fact that the communication occurred.
Courts may communicate concerning schedules, calendars, court records, and other administrative matters without making a record.
